The Site route list was missing the quickstart key mint, the SDK telemetry relay /v1/client/observe and the OAuth login and consent pages. It also did not record that the old book's backend manifest needs only the chain, while the code also needs the AA gateway and the indexer.

designFindings: Concept graph: I recomputed it from every non-test `#<concept>` import. It has 108 edges. 15 of the 17 concepts form one strongly connected component, and 29 concept pairs import each other. Payments depends on 11 concepts, and 9 of them import payments back: accounts, activity, banking, books, documents, organizations, payroll, permissions, requests. Organizations is imported by 15 of the 16 others, and access and accounts by 13 each. There is no layering at all.

The door rule holds; the direction does not. All 1022 cross-concept named imports go through a path that the target's index.ts re-exports (CONTEXT-MAP.md:35 rule). So the problem is the cyclic dependency direction, not code bypassing the doors.

indexing and operator have no index.ts door and no `#<concept>` entry. They are reachable only through the catch-all `"#*": "./src/*.ts"` (packages/backend/package.json:24). The context map says every concept has a door (CONTEXT-MAP.md:35). convex/schema.ts:35 and :49 import their tables.

Infrastructure imports a domain concept: src/platform imports #access (platform/session.ts:5, platform/proof-controls/receipt-policy.ts:37). CONTEXT-MAP.md:71 calls platform infrastructure, not a concept.

Component loop. The backend reads the indexer (integrations/ponder/service.ts:61). The indexer fetches the backend Site's JWKS on every token check (apps/indexer/src/auth.ts:42, :92), but its README says 'the indexer never calls Convex' (apps/indexer/README.md:35).

Documentation contradicts code in several places. CONTEXT-MAP.md:29 says 16 concepts but its table lists 17. payroll/README.md:5 says three tables; tables.ts defines eight. access/README.md omits referrals/. devnet README.md:49 says `up` copies CapxulPaymentsV3, but the code installs Protocol v4 only. environments.md:30 says per-worktree, but the devnet README.md:21 says singular. The old book's backend.yaml needs only chain and indexer.yaml needs the whole devnet; neither matches the runtime dependencies. The staging release trigger is master in environments.md:187 but integration/main in deploy.md:361.

Staging configuration has no single owner. Backend names live in the env:apply plan (packages/tools/.../convex-env-plan.ts:7, :27, :124). Indexer names live only as masked Openship service variables, and their values cannot be copied back (deploy.md:679-685). Operator names live in the topology worker profile (deployment-topology.json:49). The backend's INDEXER_URL and INDEXER_SERVICE_TOKEN appear in none of these, and no runbook says how they are set.

The CLI and the loopback wallet page reach around the SDK to the backend Site in three places: native revoke, the quickstart key mint, and /convex/token plus /encryption-session (apps/cli/src/signer/bridge-upstream.ts:114, :124). The SDK is therefore not the CLI's only door to the backend.
